name: @hibuddy/desktop-shell
description: HiBuddy desktop shell: Electron main process owning the window, tray, and the RunAsNode host lifecycle (ADR-004)

scripts.deploy:profile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build/profile',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm --filter hibuddy-profile deploy --prod --node-linker hoisted build/profile
scripts.dist: pnpm run deploy:host && pnpm run deploy:profile && node scripts/materialize-deploy.mjs build/host build/profile && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.mjs
